title: Insulin Pump Program Remittance Correction Worksheet: Supported Patient Responsibility
content:
A billing correction on an Insulin Pump Program reviews the remittance posting the program's approved hardship application names and reverses the part of its patient responsibility that the remittance does not support, as follows.

## Part 1 — The reviewed line

The reviewed line is the shipment the remittance's claim bills; its item, units and supply days are read from that shipment, and its grant is the authorization grant it drew on.

## Part 2 — Units, value and responsibility

- **Covered rate.** The standard covered rate of the reviewed line is the tier's reservoirs per 30 days.
- **Covered and denied units.** The line's covered units are its covered units per 30 days times its supply days divided by 30, never more than its units, and its denied units are the rest of its units.
- **Value of a denied unit.** The standard value of a denied unit is the Larkfield cash price of the line's item: $6.85 for an A4225 cartridge, $7.10 for an A4232 reservoir, $38.40 for an A4224 infusion-set supply, $395.00 for an A4239 sensor allowance, and for an E0784 pump the cash price of the pump model on the program — $6295.00 for a Tandem t:slim X2, $4995.00 for a Tandem Mobi, $7350.00 for a MiniMed 780G and $5250.00 for a Beta Bionics iLet.
- **Member responsibility.** The remittance's allowed amount less the payer's payment, or the posted amount where the remittance itemizes no allowed amount, never below zero.

## Part 3 — Result

- **Standard computation.** In the standard computation the supported responsibility is the member responsibility, and the correction is the remittance posting's amount less the billing corrections already posted against it, less that supported responsibility, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Combination.** Any adjustment to these standard figures changes the standard figure it names, replacements first, then the amounts taken off the member responsibility, never below zero, then any scaling of it; the supported responsibility is the member responsibility so changed, rounded half up to the cent, and the correction is the remittance posting's amount less the billing corrections already posted against it, less the supported responsibility, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Standard computation worked through (hypothetical remittance on a 90-day A4225 line of 30 units)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Allowed amount; payer paid | $205.50; $164.40 |
| Member responsibility, supported | $41.10 |
| Posted amount; earlier billing corrections | $61.10; none |
| Correction | $61.10 less $41.10, which is $20.00 |
